edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Lead promotes vascular oxidative stress and impairs nitric-oxide signaling while also affecting renal sodium handling, a plausible route to higher blood pressure.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Yang meta analysis in Front Public Health already points to occupational lead exposure tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
